Cross-match blood for transfusion and organ transplantation

cond_0483.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. The role involves performing complex laboratory tests on blood, body fluids, cells, and tissues. You will identify bacteria, parasites, and other microorganisms, analyze chemical content of fluids, cross match blood for transfusion and organ transplantation, and aseptically prepare cells for use in cellular therapies. You will regularly communicate findings that are used in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease, working closely with colleagues across the department on a day-to-day basis.
cond_0483.responsibilities:
Perform complex laboratory tests on blood, body fluids, cells, and tissues.
Identify bacteria, parasites, and other microorganisms.
Analyze chemical content of fluids.
Cross match blood for transfusion and organ transplantation.
Aseptically prepare cells for use in cellular therapies.
Communicate test results that contribute to diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease, staying in regular contact with the broader team to clarify findings and address questions as they arise.
cond_0483.requirements:
Associate's degree in Laboratory Science or Medical Laboratory Technology from an accredited program (NAACLS/ABHES), or an Associate degree from a regionally or nationally accredited college/university with 6 semester hours of chemistry, 6 semester hours of biology, and 12 semester hours of courses in chemistry, biology, or medical laboratory technology in any combination, plus proof of eligibility to sit for an applicable certification exam (ASCP, AMT, ACHI or equivalent).
Medical Lab Technician Certification through ASCP, AMT, ACHI, or an equivalent certification agency must be obtained within 18 months of employment.
Applicants trained outside of [Location masked] must provide documentation of equivalency evaluation of their education and training to confirm it meets CLIA requirements. Evaluations must be performed by a nationally recognized organization (e.g., NACES, AICE). The applicant is responsible for the cost of the equivalency evaluation.
All individuals selected for a position will undergo a background check appropriate for the position's responsibilities.
